name: RASHU CUP
description: The region's premier MLBB cup. Euphex entered as defending champions and opened the group with a statement draft phase.

journey.title: Matchday 1
journey.text: Draft masterclass — 2–0 control series, zero Lords conceded.

journey.title: Matchday 2
journey.text: 2–2 draw vs Halcyon Five after a 24-minute Lord throw. Lessons logged.

name: OPEN CIRCUIT #5
description: Aurex's first bracket test against seasoned open-circuit grinders.

name: AUREX CLASH
description: Aurex's revenge run — semifinal rematch vs Iron Lynx Academy.

name: MIDNIGHT INVITATIONAL
description: Euphex lifted the trophy 3–1 over Apex Falcons. Nawrrr's engages closed the door in Game 4.

name: CONTINENTAL QUALIFIER
description: Quarterfinal exit to Orbital Nine. The loss that rebuilt the draft book.

name: OPEN CIRCUIT #4
description: Aurex announced themselves with a 2–1 upset over Cinder Wolves.
